ledger.x: c. 947: the Jamts' assembly, the Jamtamót, governs Jämtland as a peasant republic. Jamtamót page: 'Founded in the first half of the 10th century, it was one of the oldest elected assemblies in the world'; 'The Jamtamót initially had no king over it'. Jämtland page: 'originally an autonomous republic' (no year). The…
1178: the Jamts lose the Battle of Storsjön and the republic ends.

wars.name: Battle of Storsjön
wars.outcome: The Jamts lost the Battle of Storsjön in 1178 and Jämtland came under Norwegian control, where it stayed until 1645.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary of Jämtland; the shape follows the modern province's mountain and forest edges and is soft throughout.
